meta.title: ImpactMap section index crashes with React error #31 for relation files with goal-as-object

content.tldr: Navigating to /wiki/impact-map throws React error #31 ('Objects are not valid as a React child') because the section index preview loader used d.goal directly as a string — but invoice-relations, order-relations, and product-relations store goal as { statement, metric, deadline }.
steps_to_reproduce: Open the wiki-app in a browser.
Click Impact Map in the sidebar (or navigate to /wiki/impact-map).
Observe a blank page and the following console error: 'Error: Minified React error #31; object with keys {statement, metric, deadline}'
content.expected_behavior: The impact-map section index should list all relation files as preview cards, showing the goal statement as a readable string excerpt.
content.actual_behavior: The page crashes with React error #31 because the preview loader set tldr = d.goal (an object), which React cannot render as a child node.
content.root_cause: In wiki-app/app/wiki/[section]/page.tsx, the loadPreview() function had: `(d.goal as string | undefined)`. TypeScript cast does not convert the value at runtime — for files that use goal: { statement, metric, deadline }, the object was silently passed through and then rendered verbatim in JSX, triggering error #31.

audit.author: vibe-qa-general
audit.note: Bug identified: section index page crashes on impact-map because goal object is passed directly into JSX.

audit.author: vibe-frontend-general
audit.note: Fixed loadPreview() to unpack goal object; created BugView.tsx for readable bug pages.
